name: Lambda@Edge Defense Envelope Hardening
description: Eliminate the toxic primitive at the L@E / CloudFront boundary where `custom_error_response` collapses S3 NoSuchKey / NoSuchBucket / 403 into SPA HTML on artifact-class (.json) URLs — which React Query then silently caches as data:null for staleTime, poisoning subsequent reads. Two options on the architectural fork: Option A (origin-response L@E with structured JSON error envelope) or Option B (path-scoped CloudFront behavior with conditional custom_error_response). Either eliminates the toxic source primitive; defense-in-depth complement to DE 0.4 FE-side fix cb62f069 (drop refetchOnMount: false on the demonstrated-poisoning useQuery). Empirically anchored on 2026-05-14 P1 (Inflection Segment Analytics Annual data unavailable; root caused to React Query cache poisoning from pre-17b3dad7 ROUTER_FIRM_SUFFIX deploy-window URL-shape change).
